# Roamify — Multi-Generational Family Travel Itineraries

> Custom, human-verified vacation itineraries engineered specifically for multi-generational families (toddlers, parents, and grandparents).

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **4-Pass Verification System**: Mobility audit (step counts, elevators, benches), real-time venue status, pacing guardrails (2-hour daily rest / nap blocks), and daily contingency/medical points.
- **Multi-Age Pacing**: Balances energy levels between infants/toddlers (stroller routes, nursing cafes) and seniors (step-free access, wheelchair/cane friendly).
- **Delivery Format**: Complete day-by-day itineraries with verified Google Map links for all destinations, attractions, and dining.

## Package Plans & Pricing
- **Weekend Getaway ($49 USD)**: 2–3 days trip, 1 destination, 2-day delivery, 1 revision included.
- **Full Week Plan ($99 USD)**: 4–7 days trip, up to 2 cities, 3–5 days delivery, 1 revision included.
- **Complete Family Package ($149 USD)**: 8–14 days trip, multi-city/region, 5–7 days delivery, 2 revisions included.
